RAI FARHAN
AI/ML & Computer Vision Engineer
Nankana Sahib, Pakistan | (+92) 3008582139 | raifarhan000@gmail.com | github.com/RaiFarhan0
SUMMARY
AI/ML engineer building computer vision, multi-agent and LLM-powered systems, from real-time detection to
local-first AI apps. Shipped projects in deepfake detection, sign language translation and email automation. Open
to remote roles.
EXPERIENCE
Freelance AI Developer | Independent | 2025 to Present
• Built and delivered AI and automation projects for international clients across computer vision, LLM and web
scraping work.
• Developed multi-threaded scrapers with proxy rotation and fail-safe request handling to deliver clean,
structured datasets.
PROJECTS
Deepfake Detection System (rPPG) | Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, SciPy
• Built a remote photoplethysmography pipeline that extracts heart-rate signals from facial video.
• Applied band-pass filtering, FFT and spatial patch coherence analysis to separate real video from deepfakes.
SignAi: Real-Time ASL to Speech | PyTorch, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, FastAPI, Next.js
• Extracted 3D hand landmarks with MediaPipe for continuous ASL gesture recognition.
• Trained an MLP classifier and deployed it via ONNX Runtime and FastAPI WebSockets for low-latency
inference.
Dubbed: CPU-Based Audio Dubbing Pipeline | Faster-Whisper, CTranslate2, Piper TTS
• Built an end-to-end dubbing pipeline that runs on CPU-only machines with 8GB RAM.
• Combined Faster-Whisper transcription, CTranslate2 and Piper TTS into one automated flow.
INVOX: AI Email Automation | FastAPI, Next.js, Gmail API OAuth 2.0, pgvector, Ollama
• Built a local-first email triage system using vector embeddings and Ollama-hosted LLMs.
• Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication and pgvector semantic search for fast email retrieval.
CCTV Anomaly Detection | YOLOv8, Flask, Socket.IO
• Fine-tuned YOLOv8 for difficult lighting and occlusion to reduce false positives.
• Streamed live alerts to a dashboard through Socket.IO.
Text-to-Handwriting Generator | TensorFlow
• Built a neural network that synthesizes cursive handwriting from text, integrated with batch generation.
SKILLS
• Languages: Python, C++, JavaScript/TypeScript
• AI/ML: PyTorch, TensorFlow, YOLOv8, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, CrewAI, LangChain, Ollama,
Faster-Whisper
• Computer Vision: OpenCV, rPPG, FFT/SciPy, object and anomaly detection
• Backend/Web: FastAPI, Flask, Socket.IO, Next.js, REST APIs, pgvector
• Automation: Playwright, BeautifulSoup, multi-threaded pipelines
EDUCATION
FSc Pre-Engineering | Pak Garrison Education System, Nankana Sahib | 2019 to 2021
LANGUAGES
Urdu (native) | English (C2 writing, C1/C2 speaking)
